event.title: National Transfer Student Week (NTSW)
event.description:
National Transfer Student Week is an annual, week-long program designed to celebrate you and connect you with folks in our transfer community! Here's what we have planned:

Monday, October 19

  • Pizza & Puzzles
    • 1:00 - 2:30 PM in Goodell 633
  • Five College Hampshire Transfer Mixer
    • 4:00-6:00 PM in the Cape Cod Lounge

Tuesday, October 20

  • Study Abroad Panel for Transfer Students
    • 12:00-1:00 PM in Goodell 633 and on Zoom
  • Tote Bag Painting 
    • 5:00-7:00 PM in Goodell 633

Wednesday, October 21

  • Anxiety Club Movie Showing and Discussion 
    • 7:30-9:30 PM in the Computer Science Laboratories (CSL) Building, room E-110

Thursday, October 22

  • Panel on Research Resources for Undergraduate Students
    • 5:00-7:00 PM in Lederle Graduate Research Tower (LGRT) Room 1681

Friday, October 23

  • NTSW Pop-Up
    • 12:00-4:00 PM at the Farme
